scope: Publish exact source/results bytes with bounded, reconstructible byte chunks.

summary.scope: Archive closed physical-reference fields, qualifications and diagnostics without accepting physical convergence.

extended-native-capsule-level0-independe.scope: Freshly audit actual native finite-load fields, including independent physical-point P2 traction scatter.
extended-native-capsule-level0-independe.limitations: Actual native force/RHS/displacements and every raw corner component/peak retain the original complete1e-11N absolute/1e-8 relative equilibrium and1e-4 relative/1e-3Pa raw-field gates. Fresh independent quadrature checks reconstruct the native displacement field, not a different exact-solve displacement. The manufactured/old-field-qualified P2 physical-point locator independently scatters every retained native traction sample without using its stored face or basis. Unsupported and rejected rows remain explicit. Source charts are per input source, not independently identified continuum contact islands. Same-mesh numerical agreement and cold runtime do not establish spatial/geometry/contact/model accuracy, feedback or warmed cost.

limitations: Complete four runs retain all five loads/four models at identical physical inputs. Ports4/8/16 with quadrature10 and ports8 with quadrature14 each have a separate fresh auditor;76 native fields and four unsupported pressure free-moment rows remain. Original force/physical-scatter/corner/quadrature/energy/source/friction gates remain unchanged. These data do not establish mesh/geometry/contact/model continuum error, feedback, application accuracy or warmed cost. Files of at least50MB are preserved as exact ordered32MiB byte ranges, individually gzip-compressed, with original/part/stored SHA256 and offsets. Join decompressed ranges in index order to restore the original file exactly; no records are reduced or excluded. Runtime staging uses hard links for unchanged small originals.
